subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call
body_text:
Hi Kabir,

Thank you for taking the time to speak with us on our support call. If you have any remaining questions or need further help, please reply to this email and we will be glad to assist.

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-F4

Warm regards,
Sameer
FlexiFunnels Support
caveats: Transcript was substantially garbled; email is a neutral thank-you with no content claims.
